## Planning basis and readiness

### Purpose

Provide a practical companion for Ash’s next working sessions:

1. Prioritised preparation queue.
2. Menu, footer and human-facing sitemap checklist.
3. Light/dark discrepancy assessment.
4. First-episode podcast website brief.

This document organises preparation, evidence and decisions. It is not another implementation specification.

[Figma Make specification and prompt pack — Book website launch](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/document/figma-make-specification-and-prompt-pack-book-website-launch-33f83ff4f8cc) **v1.0.0**, updated **9 November 2026, 04:13:21.101 UTC**, supplies the staged prompts, requirement IDs, exact-preview gates and manual GitHub checkpoint contract.

**Preparation can continue; execution is Not ready.**

The exact editable Make revision, source parity, available credits and separate authority to resume remain unresolved. This companion is saved in Linear; persistence does not resolve those conditions or establish approval of its contents.

## Recommended approach and alternatives

Prepare navigation independently, reconcile shared themes before visual refinement, and define one complete podcast episode before optional expansion.

| Approach | Position |
| -- | -- |
| Bounded preparation while paused | Recommended: advances decisions without changing source systems. |
| Visual refinement before theme reconciliation | Defer: risks reproducing contradictory tokens and theme behaviour. |
| Podcast expansion before one playable episode | Defer: increases scope without resolving media, eligibility or editorial authority. |
| Broad redesign or replacement design system | Outside scope: preserve existing foundations and canonical work. |

The saved specification’s Prompt 0 remains the source-verification entry point. It is referenced here, not invoked.

### WP-02 — Menu-change checklist

Static evidence: [router](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/routes.ts>), [navigation/footer data](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/data/mock/book-site.ts>) and [human sitemap](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/pages/SitemapPage.tsx>).

| Surface | Recorded exposure treatment | Preserve |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Desktop/mobile menu | Remove Events → `/events`, Speaking → `/speaking`, Media → `/media`. | Underlying pages/routes, unrelated entries and retained relative order. |
| Footer | Remove Events → `/events`, Speaking & Workshops → `/speaking`, Media & Press → `/media`. | About Ash, Contact and unrelated groups/destinations. |
| Human sitemap | Omit those three destinations, generic Thank you → `/thank-you`, and Style guide → `/style-guide`. | Underlying pages and distinct confirmation journeys. |
| Human sitemap reader cards | Withhold Draft viewer → `/draft-viewer` and Ebook reader → `/ebook`. | Read the draft → `/read-the-draft`. |

This corresponds to NAV-01/NAV-02 and Prompt 1. Do not rename, reorder or add unrelated entries. Preserve the existing footer group heading unless separately approved.

The inspected header uses one shared overlay; both desktop and narrow-screen presentations still require verification.

Other current menu destinations are `/`, `/the-book`, `/about-ash`, `/journal`, `/contact`, `/waitlist` and `/search`. `/read-the-book` is a registered alias to the draft-entry page, not authority for another navigation item.

#### Findings requiring separate treatment

* `/draft-viewer` is unregistered.
* `/ebook` exists, but registration does not settle its exposure, purpose or access protection.
* Footer legal buttons target unregistered `/privacy` and `/terms`.
* Sitemap/Style Guide properties in the footer-data file have no consumers identified in the inspected source; the file itself is used for other footer content. These properties do not establish active navigation exposure.
* Makeup-branded social destinations are wired into the book shell. Their ownership, suitability and book-specific approval remain unverified.
* Podcasts has no active registered route or approved global-navigation addition.

At commit `84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f`, [footer-data lines 17–22](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/data/mock/ui/footer.ts#L17-L22>) define the Sitemap and Style Guide properties. No consumers of those two properties were found in the scoped source search. The active [Footer implementation](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/common/Footer.tsx#L36-L98>) instead renders navigation from `bookSiteData.footerGroups`. This finding concerns unused properties, not an unused file or absent pages.

The [social destination data](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/data/mock/ui/social-links.ts#L33-L69>) includes makeup-branded YouTube and email destinations. [SocialLinks](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/common/SocialLinks.tsx#L76-L125>) renders the configured URLs through anchors, with consumers in the [footer](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/common/Footer.tsx#L117-L118>) and [header](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/common/Header.tsx#L224>). This establishes source wiring, not destination reachability, current Make parity or approval for book use. No social-link or footer-data change is authorised.

#### Indexing distinction

Recorded policy retains Speaking/workshops, Events and Media/press at public direct URLs, removes menu/footer exposure and applies noindex. Enforcement is unverified.

The [XML sitemap](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/public/sitemap.xml>) still lists those pages using `ashshaw.com`. [robots.txt](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/public/robots.txt>) permits crawling and references that origin. Inspected SEO/root configuration does not establish effective noindex.

XML sitemap changes, robots rules, noindex, canonical-origin changes, access control and search-removal verification remain separate from navigation exposure.

**Acceptance inputs:** exact before/after entries, retained-route inventory and later authorised checks for open/close, Escape, focus return, keyboard containment, scrolling and layout. Existing failures must remain distinguishable from regressions.

**Dependency:** current Make equivalents and the specification’s separately approved navigation stage.

**Smallest next action:** compare this inventory with Make parity findings; stop affected mappings where destinations differ.

### WP-03 — Light/dark discrepancy assessment

#### Approved foundations

* Space Grotesk headings; Inter body/UI.
* Palette: `#0B0B10`, `#12121A`, `#171722`, `#F6F2EB`, `#CFC7BB`, `#9C9488`, `#FF3AAE`, `#F4FF3C`, `#8A63FF`.
* Both themes, switching and saved-light preferences.
* Dark-first reconciliation—not dark-only launch.
* Existing `/style-guide` with nine sections/anchors: `brand`, `colors`, `typography`, `buttons`, `forms`, `cards`, `tags`, `icons`, `content`.

Exact semantic/component mappings and remaining default/system-preference/persistence decisions are unresolved. R3/T1/RT2/C1 are not adopted. Logo revision, artwork lettering, rights and credits remain separately gated.

#### Static discrepancies

| Layer | Finding | Preparation implication |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Primitives | `globals.css` uses `#0F0F0F` and `#FF10F0` instead of approved black/pink. Guidelines introduce another palette. | Trace approved primitives through consumers, not swatches alone. |
| Imports | Active entry imports `default_theme.css`, then `globals.css` and additional theme/book layers. Separate `theme.css` is outside the inspected active chain. | Establish actual import precedence before proposing changes. |
| Aliases | Generic, WordPress-style and legacy aliases coexist. | Map semantic/component relationships explicitly. |
| Overrides | Book dark-mode CSS reintroduces conflicting colours, gradients and `!important` rules. | Inventory state/component exceptions; avoid indiscriminate replacement. |
| Typography | Heading/body aliases broadly match; menu UI, brand treatments and style-guide examples conflict. | Separate text roles from approved artwork exceptions. |
| Switching | Header has independent stored state. Footer depends on provider context; no provider wraps the inspected entry composition, leaving its fallback setter ineffective. | Define consistent state behaviour preserving saved light. |
| Style guide | Nova News identity, conflicting swatches/fonts and hardcoded specimens remain. | Refine the existing page; no duplicate or invented logo. |

Sources: [global styles](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/styles/globals.css>) and [style-guide page](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/pages/StyleGuidePage.tsx>).

The bounded DR-02 source inspection located three additional findings at commit `84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f`:

* **Theme selector/target mismatch:** [style-guide CSS lines 462–519](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/styles/blocks/style-guide-page.css#L462-L519>) uses `body.dark`, while [ThemeToggleES5 lines 23–27](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/common/ThemeToggleES5.tsx#L23-L27>) targets `document.documentElement` (`html`). This confirms a static mismatch, not failure of the entire dark-theme presentation; inherited and global styling may still apply.
* **Swatch keyboard activation:** [StyleGuidePage lines 390–401](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/pages/StyleGuidePage.tsx#L390-L401>) creates focusable `div` elements with click handlers, button roles and accessible labels. No keyboard activation handler was found in that file. This is a static implementation gap, not an executed keyboard test.
* **Nested main elements and duplicate ID:** the [route composition](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/routes.ts#L30-L51>) places the style-guide page under RootLayout. [RootLayout lines 251–258](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/common/RootLayout.tsx#L251-L258>) wraps its outlet in `main` with `id="main-content"`; [StyleGuidePage lines 274–276](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/pages/StyleGuidePage.tsx#L274-L276>) returns another main element with the same ID. This establishes the source-composition problem, not browser or assistive-technology verification.

These findings provide precise source locations for later bounded proposals. They do not establish current Make parity, accessibility conformance or authority to expand implementation scope. No tests, application execution or browser checks were performed during this investigation.

#### Evidence classification

| Check | Position |
| -- | -- |

| Calculated contrast | Not run |
| Computed styles/font loading | Not run |
| Browser switching/reload/persistence | Not run |

| Make/source parity | Evidence Pending |

**Acceptance inputs:** approved role/state matrix for both themes; actual contrast pairs; font exceptions; shared-control behaviour; saved-light reload/navigation expectations; storage fallback decisions; preservation of unrelated reader preferences and all nine style-guide sections.

**Dependencies:** shared-theme reconciliation under Prompt 2A precedes affected style-guide refinement under Prompt 2B. An existing third mode must not be removed without approval.

**Smallest next action:** prepare the source-to-token-to-consumer matrix; keep shared repairs distinct from style-guide-local corrections.

### WP-04 — Podcast website brief

#### Objective and experience

Give visitors a clear introduction to the show and one approved episode they can genuinely play and access through checked equivalent text.

Proposed journey:

**Show introduction → eligible episode summary → canonical detail → playback/equivalent text → optional verified listening destination.**

Episodes two and three remain optional and individually approved. Do not fabricate cards, audio, duration, publication status or external platform links.

#### Existing work mappings

| Record | Boundary |
| -- | -- |
| [TOA-441](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/issue/TOA-441) | Brief, decisions and coordination |
| [TOA-309](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/issue/TOA-309) | Editorial/runtime contract, eligibility and diagnostics |
| [TOA-310](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/issue/TOA-310) | Routes, archives, taxonomy and counts |
| [TOA-311](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/issue/TOA-311) | Genuine accessible playback |
| [TOA-90](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/issue/TOA-90) | Introductory editorial reconciliation |
| [TOA-420](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/issue/TOA-420) | Hosting/Figma research |
| [TOA-410](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/issue/TOA-410) | Later offline integration; excluded initially |

No replacement epic or duplicate backlog is proposed.

#### Static evidence

* Podcast components exist but are not registered in the active router.
* [Episode data](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/data/mock/podcasts/episodes.ts>) uses placeholder audio.
* [Podcast detail](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/src/app/components/pages/podcasts/PodcastDetailPage.tsx>) simulates time/progress rather than playing audio.
* Markdown and TypeScript narratives coexist without resolved authority; Markdown edits alone do not establish runtime changes.
* Podcast-labelled Journal content is not evidence of working playback.

#### Decisions required

| Area | Required input |
| -- | -- |
| Show identity | Approved title, description, artwork and relationship to the book |
| Source authority | Canonical editorial source and runtime transformation; Markdown plus adapter remains a recommendation |
| Canonical routes/origin | Approved archive/detail patterns and origin; preserve singular/plural distinctions |
| Hosting | Approved real media source, delivery behaviour and access policy |
| Eligibility | Explicit preview/public rules, including exclusion from public data/counts |
| First episode | Approved source/audio revisions, recording-checked equivalent text, accurate date/duration |
| Rights and credits | Applicable artwork, music, voice and other permissions/disclosures |
| Editorial truth | Clarify the located South Africa and Berlin origin passages against their intended milestone meanings and the episode actually selected. The source wording raises an unresolved chronology question; it does not establish autobiographical truth or a blocker for every episode. Distinguish notes, scripts and recording-checked text. |

Do not infer approval from filenames, `publishedAt` values or mock data.

**Located chronology evidence:** at commit `84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f`, the [introduction candidate, lines 39–44](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/content/podcasts/welcome-to-neon-vs-atomic-black.md#L39-L44>) says: “I started painting faces spontaneously on the dancefloor at a small psytrance gathering in South Africa.” The [dancefloor candidate, lines 33–43](<https://github.com/lightspeedwp/ThisOneTimeOnAcidCom/blob/84242de7857e1ec03742e20aaaf1df469f44355f/content/podcasts/the-dancefloor-gave-me-everything.md#L33-L43>), under “Berlin, July 2019”, says “I had never touched a makeup brush before” and refers to “That first face I painted”.

Earlier spontaneous painting and first makeup-brush use could be different milestones, but the “first face” wording prevents a confident reconciliation from these passages alone. Ash’s clarification remains required before treating either account as approved factual material. Neither source was established as recording-checked text. Applicability depends on the episode actually selected; locating these passages does not select an episode, approve adaptation or establish rights.

#### Required states and acceptance inputs

* **Loading/buffering:** truthful status without fabricated progress.
* **Ready/playing/paused/ended:** actual media-driven duration/progress; no autoplay.
* **Failure/unavailable:** useful explanation, recovery and approved equivalent text.
* **Empty/ineligible:** no phantom episode, misleading count or exposure of preview-only material.
* **Accessible controls:** labelled keyboard-operable playback/seeking, visible focus, proportionate announcements and usable reflow.
* **Navigation:** direct loading, refresh, unknown/unpublished-item recovery and cleanup when leaving playback.
* **Content:** equivalent text clearly distinguished from show notes, with approved media/text revisions and credits.

Acceptance requires one eligible approved episode to play genuinely from its canonical detail destination. Static source inspection cannot establish that result.

The conditional journal requirement—three approved entries and a clear purpose—remains unchanged.

**Dependencies:** Prompt 3A decisions/data contract → Prompt 3B routes/presentation → Prompt 3C playback, each under the specification’s separate gates.

**Smallest next action:** assemble the first-episode decision packet before expanding layouts.

## Decisions and go/no-go criteria

### Preserved decisions

* Personal book scope and existing routing.
* Remove deferred-page exposure while retaining pages.
* Preserve both themes and saved-light preferences.
* Refine the existing nine-section style guide.
* Begin with one approved playable podcast episode.
* Preserve the implementation pause.

### Unresolved conditions

* Exact editable Make revision, parity and access.
* Available credits and separately approved generation scope.
* Explicit authority to resume each affected stage.
* Remaining mappings, light/persistence behaviour and logo permissions.
* Podcast identity, sources, routes/origin, hosting, eligibility, audio/text and rights.
* Authorised verification and accepted exceptions.
* Scope of the every-occurrence skill-reference check.

**Go:** bounded read-only preparation with explicit uncertainty.

**No-go:** execution, publication or claims of verified parity while affected prerequisites remain unresolved.

### Skill-reference position

The historical reference audit is recorded in [TOA - Plan Figma Make book website work](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/agent/toa-plan-figma-make-book-website-work-a877bde42d816) and was performed on 9 November 2026, 03:36:28–03:36:47 UTC. It inspected the complete saved body of [design-work-planner](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/settings/skill/f16ae94664f6/edit), v1.1.1, updated 4 November 2026, 14:09:45.666 UTC. The current version and timestamp match that historical baseline; the DR-03 investigation did not perform a complete byte-for-byte comparison.

The audit found 30 ordinary Markdown settings-link occurrences, resolving to 12 distinct skills, and zero native skill mentions in the retrieved saved body. It found no identity mismatch and verified Ash’s access at that inspection. This does not establish other recipients’ access, future availability or Figma access.

The original user prompt selected [design-work-planner](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/settings/skill/f16ae94664f6/edit) through a native mention and selected no optional specialist hand-off. It stated:

> Before calling this prompt or its result ready, verify that every selected skill and every named skill hand-off is a live verified native AiPrompt mention inside this prompt, including all repeated occurrences. The current [skill-suggester](https://linear.app/lightspeedwp/settings/skill/be9e227f4ea3/edit), v2.6.10, updated 8 November 2026, 04:19:41.407 UTC, distinguishes generated prompts from catalogue navigation:

The earlier audit broadened its inspection to the selected planning skill’s saved-body links and concluded that the inherited prompt failed the all-occurrences gate. The planning skill also states:

> Before requesting design context, read the current official figma-design-to-code guidance.

The latter wording supplies no source URL or identity. It could denote official Figma operational documentation or a reusable workflow; a linked workflow elsewhere does not settle the intended source of this bare phrase. The earlier clarification question remained unanswered in the inspected history. No design-context operation was performed during the audit, so this is an unresolved prerequisite-source interpretation, not an observed failed operation.

These evidence questions remain separate:

* **Identity and requester access:** resolved for the 12 linked records at the historical inspection; other recipients’ access and future availability remain unverified.
* **Requirement applicability:** whether the native-reference gate extends to the referenced skill’s full embedded catalogue remains unresolved. The saved-body link count alone establishes neither a violation nor compliance.
* **Companion rendering:** retrieved rich text exposes native mentions. An earlier escaped representation does not prove broken rendering in Linear.
* **Transfer into Make:** readable labels, usable URLs, source access and copied/exported representation remain untested.
* **Guidance source:** the intended “current official figma-design-to-code guidance” remains unidentified.

These gaps prevent a fully verified prompt-transfer claim, not honest recording of a qualified working draft. No referenced workflow is invoked, no skill is amended and the implementation pause remains unchanged.
